title: RSSB Clerk Jr-II / Junior Assistant Answer Key 2026 – Out
postName: Clerk Grade-II (LDC) / Junior Assistant Combined Direct Recruitment 2026 – Advt. 04/2026
vacancyDetails: Primary answer key for Clerk Grade-II / Junior Assistant written exam (Paper-I & Paper-II)
qualification: Senior Secondary / as per RSSB LDC Grade-II & Junior Assistant rules
selectionProcess: Written Exam (Paper-I & II) → Typing / Skill Test as applicable → DV
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials for login, photo ID for record
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open Answer Key section
3. Select LDC Grade-II / Junior Assistant Primary Answer Key
4. Download Paper-I (DG28) and Paper-II (BB6) PDFs
5. Raise objections 26–28/29 July 2026 if required
shortDescription: RSSB Clerk Jr-II / Junior Assistant Answer Key 2026 out on 24 July for exam held on 5 July 2026. Objection window around 26–28 July.
content:
Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the primary answer key for Clerk Grade-II / Junior Assistant Combined Direct Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 04/2026) on 24 July 2026.

Exam date: 5 July 2026. Separate keys for Paper-I and Paper-II. Candidates can raise objections from about 26 to 28/29 July 2026 on the official portal.

Download from rssb.rajasthan.gov.in Answer Key section.
